notes: All 15 morphemes accounted for; מֵאַיִן takes two English words (From, whence) for its two morphemes under rule 2, and the assimilated article of לַמַּעֲלוֹת is correctly unrepresented under rule 12.
lift up kept whole on נָשָׂא: the particle restates the direction inherent in the lexeme rather than adding one the Hebrew does not write (rule 44, as find out / gather together).
